descriptions.shortDescription: Schedule autonomous AI agents in Nextcloud
descriptions.longDescription:
Hermiq brings autonomous AI agents to Nextcloud. Define an agent, give
it tools, and run it on a schedule — daily reports, inbox triage,
monitoring, morning briefings — all inside your own Nextcloud,
delivered to Nextcloud Talk. Agents, their memory and their
self-improving skills are stored as OpenRegister objects, so every run
is governed, auditable and multi-tenant.

results.title: Project health (CHAOSS)
results.description: How active and widely carried the project is: the bus factor, the spread over organisations, how change requests and issues are handled, and how often it releases. Informative: shown, not rated.
results.message: 6 of 6 CHAOSS metrics measured. They are shown for information and do not count in any rating.

metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the commits on the default branch in the last 12 months, of the 100 contributors GitHub reports, among 5 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the latest 300 commits of the last 12 months (200 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is conduction.nl (4 authors), with 100% of the 200 commits whose organisation is known; 0% of the commits come from 0 of 4 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.

metrics.name: Change Request Closure Ratio
metrics.explanation: 1,176 change requests were closed (merged or not) and 1,247 opened in the last 90 days, bots included. Below 1 the open backlog grows; above 1 it shrinks.

metrics.name: Time to First Response
metrics.explanation: None of the 15 latest change requests opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13 got a comment or review from anyone but its author.

metrics.name: Issue Response Time
metrics.explanation: None of the 4 latest issues opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13 got a comment from anyone but its author.

metrics.name: Release Frequency
metrics.explanation: 7 final releases were published in the last 12 months, about one every 52 days, counted from the GitHub releases. The latest final release is from 2026-09-06. Besides these, 423 pre-releases were published; they are not counted. Drafts and pre-releases are left out.
